LOW.facility: Home / Community Health Post / Village Health Nurse
LOW.timeline: Routine / Elective (within 7 days if symptoms persist)
LOW.action: Maintain supportive home care, oral hydration, rest, and lifestyle adjustments. Follow up with local community health worker if symptoms do not improve in 48-72 hours.

MEDIUM.facility: Primary Health Centre (PHC) / Community Health Centre (CHC) / Outpatient Clinic
MEDIUM.action: Schedule an in-person clinical evaluation by a medical doctor. Monitor vital signs twice daily. Seek earlier medical attention if fever rises, breathing becomes labored, or pain intensifies.

HIGH.facility: Sub-District Hospital / District Hospital / Tertiary Emergency Department
HIGH.action: Proceed to the nearest emergency department or call emergency ambulance dispatch immediately. Keep the patient at rest, maintain airway, loosen clothing, and prepare identification and medication history.
